name: goalpost-guard
description: Stops Claude from passing a check by lowering the bar: weakened or deleted tests, new suppressions, relaxed config, softened CI, lowered coverage, skipped git hooks.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What happens when a change lowers the bar: ask you, deny it, let it through and tell Claude to report it (warn), or nothing. inherit follows the EMCC profile (standard asks, strict denies), and asks without emcc-core

tests.title: Guard tests
tests.description: Removed or loosened assertions, skipped or focused tests, deleted tests, rewritten snapshots, narrowed test runs

suppressions.title: Guard suppressions
suppressions.description: New @ts-ignore, eslint-disable, # noqa, # type: ignore, //nolint, #[allow], coverage ignores and the like

config.title: Guard lint and type config
config.description: tsconfig strictness turned off, lint rules lowered or removed, mypy and ruff relaxed

ci.title: Guard CI
ci.description: continue-on-error, || true, allow_failure, removed check steps and pre-commit hooks

coverage.title: Guard coverage thresholds
coverage.description: Lowered or removed coverage thresholds in jest, vitest, coverage.py, codecov and others

bypass.title: Guard git hooks
bypass.description: git commit or push --no-verify, git commit -n, HUSKY=0, SKIP=, core.hooksPath

headless.title: With no one to ask
headless.description: In claude -p and other runs with no screen, ask mode cannot ask: deny the change, or allow it and have Claude report it

commitTrailer.title: Report in commits
commitTrailer.description: Add a Goalpost-Change trailer to the next git commit for every change that was let through

testPattern.title: Extra test files
testPattern.description: A regular expression for test files with unusual names, on top of the usual ones (*.test.ts, test_*.py, *_test.go…)

ignorePaths.title: Ignored paths
ignorePaths.description: Globs Goalpost Guard leaves alone, such as vendor/** or **/generated/**
